_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via operator's own site (tyf.com), Visit Wales, Visit Pembrokeshire, and TripAdvisor listing (g552051-d1985728), all consistently placing the business at 20 High Street, St Davids, Pembrokeshire, offering coasteering/kayaking/surfing/climbing.
redFlags: Operator is based solely in St Davids, Pembrokeshire and operates exclusively on the Pembrokeshire coast — it does NOT serve brecon-beacons, gower, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, mid-wales, or (beyond loose regional grouping) south-wales. Combo pages referencing this operator for those regions are a REGION MISMATCH and should be corrected to reference Pembrokeshire-based content only, or a different operator for those regions.
Could not source a verifiable numeric Google rating or review count from any accessible page during this research pass; left null rather than guessed.

TripAdvisor page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; rating corroborated only via search snippets describing 'overwhelmingly positive' reviews, not a specific number, so tripadvisorUrl is included but rating/reviewCount are not sourced from it.

proposedOperatorData.name: TYF Adventure
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Pioneers of coasteering on the Pembrokeshire coast since 1986
proposedOperatorData.description:
TYF Adventure is an outdoor activity operator based at 20 High Street, St Davids, Pembrokeshire, credited with pioneering coasteering on the Pembrokeshire coast in the mid-1980s. Over more than 35 years the business has taken an estimated 100,000+ customers coasteering along this stretch of coastline, alongside sea kayaking, surfing, stand-up paddleboarding, rock climbing, and combined full-day 'Coastal Explorer' trips.

TYF operates exclusively within the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park around St Davids and does not run activities in other Welsh regions. It holds B Corp certification and is recognised as an early adopter of environmental and carbon-neutral business practices in the UK adventure tourism sector, alongside AALA (Adventure Activities Licensing Authority) licensing for its activities.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: The original coasteering operator on the Pembrokeshire coast, with over 35 years and 100,000+ customers of experience running the activity they pioneered.
